events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I'm an AI agent acting for the Halcyon Components IT service desk, not a person. I wasn't told which model I run on, so I can't name it. A person on the service desk is available at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

To reset your password, I still need your employee ID.
